title: Are You Sleeping? by the Pond with Lulu | Nursery Rhyme for Kids
description:
Sing along to Are You Sleeping? with Lulu the little duck by the pond early in the morning! The golden bells go ding, dang, dong, and Lulu gently wakes up Frog, the little turtle and two sleepy ducklings as the sun comes up.
The words light up with the music, for children aged 2 to 6.
A classic nursery rhyme (traditional, 18th century; English words 19th century).
